science: At fixed total mass, the nonlinear mean momentum balance redistributes mean density. The source rectifies the equation of state at unchanged local mean density while solving exact linear viscous fields. Oracle follows the fixed-mass mean state; independent staggered finite-volume reference solves first-harmonic fields plus mean continuity/momentum and mass. Root read actual source, oracle, reference, validator, grader and AUTHOR and independently checked quadrature, wall traction, fixed-mass integration and peak-amplitude factors.
public_input_review: Explicit isothermal EOS, constant viscosity, fixed walls, fixed mass, conservative mass/momentum equations, Eulerian body force per volume, periodic steady-state then small-amplitude limit, optical density harmonic normalization and mean full normal traction. No correction formula or solver mandate; exact neutral instruction, None default, fixed sigma and private image boundary verified.
calibration_review: 24 unique optical density settings repeated12times,288 readings; sigma=.0002 fixed independently of response. Strictly decreasing positive-viscosity amplitude identifies viscosity. Both controls agree identically on calibration.
grading_review: Gate .04 unchanged. Independent132cases agree within1.47e-7, refinement1.18e-7; mass/momentum and drive/dissipation checks pass. All256 noise calibrations and oracle predictions pass; all reject shortcut, min force error.28735. Local oracle7/7, shortcut4+3 intended force failures.
classification_caveat: Retaining unchanged local mean density is physical error. Correct constrained mean-state attempts with sign/factor/implementation mistakes classified separately.
bibliographic_review: Verified primary APS attribution F.E.Borgnis; pre-evaluation metadata correction preserved without scientific/public changes.
